<analysis>com.netflix.hystrix is gone on purpose: the Hystrix starter was replaced by spring-cloud-starter-circuitbreaker-resilience4j and must not be re-added. InventoryCommand extends HystrixCommand<Integer> (run() / getFallback(), called with execute()). The script turns it into a plain class with a shared io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker (ofDefaults, named after the class like Hystrix's default command key), keeps the public execute() entry point so StockService still compiles, runs the former run() body through executeCallable and returns the former getFallback() value from the catch; the HystrixCommandGroupKey super call, the @Override markers and the Hystrix imports go. A MIGRATION-TODO marks the class for the owners (instance name, timeouts).</analysis>
<script>
import re

IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r"^import\s+com\.netflix\.hystrix\.[\w.]+;\n", re.M)
CLASS_RE = re.compile(r"(public\s+class\s+(\w+))\s+extends\s+HystrixCommand<([^>{]+)>\s*\{")
SUPER_RE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*super\(HystrixCommandGroupKey[^;]*\);[ \t]*\n", re.M)
OVERRIDE_RE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*@Override[ \t]*\n(?=[ \t]*protected\s+[\w<>, ?]+\s+(run|getFallback)\(\))", re.M)
CB_IMPORT = "import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;\n"
TODO = "// MIGRATION-TODO: review Resilience4j config (instance name, timeouts)\n"


def command_files(p):
    """Java files that still extend HystrixCommand: the case's own files first, then the rest of the project
    (a caller's "cannot find symbol execute()" is fixed by porting the command class it calls)."""
    seen = []
    listed = [e.get("file") for e in p.errors if e.get("file")]
    for path in listed + p.files("**/*.java"):
        if path and path.endswith(".java") and path not in seen and p.exists(path) \
                and "extends HystrixCommand<" in p.read(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def port(text):
    m = CLASS_RE.search(text)
    if not m:
        return text
    name, value_type = m.group(2), m.group(3).strip()
    head = (f"{m.group(1)} {{\n\n"
            f"    /** Shared per command class, like the Hystrix command key (default: the class name). */\n"
            f"    private static final CircuitBreaker CIRCUIT_BREAKER = CircuitBreaker.ofDefaults(\"{name}\");")
    text = text[:m.start()] + TODO + head + text[m.end():]
    text = SUPER_RE.sub("", text)
    text = OVERRIDE_RE.sub("", text)
    first = IMPORT_RE.search(text)
    text = IMPORT_RE.sub("", text)
    if CB_IMPORT not in text:
        pos = first.start() if first else text.index("\n", text.index("package ")) + 2
        text = text[:pos] + CB_IMPORT + text[pos:]
    execute = (f"\n    /** Former HystrixCommand.execute(): run() through the circuit breaker, getFallback() on failure. */\n"
               f"    public {value_type} execute() {{\n"
               f"        try {{\n"
               f"            return CIRCUIT_BREAKER.executeCallable(this::run);\n"
               f"        }} catch (Exception e) {{\n"
               f"            return getFallback();\n"
               f"        }}\n"
               f"    }}\n")
    end = text.rstrip().rfind("}")
    return text[:end].rstrip() + "\n" + execute + "}\n"


def fix(p):
    files = command_files(p)
    if not files:
        p.log("no HystrixCommand subclass left in the case's files")
    for path in files:
        text = p.read(path)
        new = port(text)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: HystrixCommand subclass ported to a Resilience4j CircuitBreaker")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: class declaration not recognised, nothing changed")
</script>
